subject: Post-demo: Quickstart playbook + rate-cap scenarios for Hosted evaluation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Erin Zhao <erin@finadvance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Quickstart playbook + rate-cap scenarios for Hosted evaluation

Hi Erin — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so you have a single reference: 

What we heard:
- Primary goal: ship a customer-facing summarization feature integrated into your loan origination flow (low-latency, high-accuracy).
- Expected steady load: ~50 RPS for the initial tranche; peak bursts up to ~300 RPS during business hours.
- Typical request size: ~150 input tokens, ~250 output tokens (median).
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms is ideal.
- Preference: start on Hosted API to avoid infra lift, but want to understand Dedicated pricing triggers if we grow quickly.

Proposed Hosted quickstart plan (pilot):
1) Sandbox endpoint and scoped access for a 2-week pilot (we'll provide traffic slice guidance).
2) Baseline rate plan: 200 RPS baseline with configured burst up to 400 RPS for short windows; token ceilings and throttles enforced per-key.
3) Ops levers: prefix / KV caching to cut repeat-token cost, recommended batching tweaks for long-form generation.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (playbook + endpoint mapping), rate-scenarios.xlsx (cost model examples).

Ask / next actions:
- Can you confirm the steady/peak numbers above (or correct them)?
- Are there data residency or SOC2 evidence needs beyond what we reviewed?
- I'll loop in Monica from CS for a short technical sync to map endpoints and sandbox access.

If that looks right I'll propose a 30-minute technical sync with Monica + Ben early next week to lock scope and sandbox credentials.

Thanks — rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra

From: Erin Zhao <erin@finadvance.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Quickstart playbook + rate-cap scenarios for Hosted evaluation

Thanks Rishi — quick answers inline and a couple of asks.

> Expected steady load: ~50 RPS; peaks up to ~300 RPS
We expect ~50 RPS steady and agree with your peak of ~300 RPS for marketing-driven spikes. Could see short bursts up to ~500 RPS for a launch day.

> Typical request size: ~150 input / ~250 output
That's accurate (average 150/250).

> Latency target: p95 < 300ms
Yes — p95 < 300ms is our SLA requirement for user-facing completion.

Regulatory / security: we require SOC 2 evidence and the standard security questionnaire (I attached sec-request.pdf). We also prefer US-only residency for production data.

Deployment preference: we want to start on Hosted to move quickly; if we exceed ~3M tokens/month or sustained 300 RPS baseline we'll evaluate Dedicated. Can you include a short note on the Dedicated breakpoint (ops + cost) in the follow-up?

Cost ask: please provide an example mapping from token usage -> monthly cost for both Hosted and a hypothetical Dedicated commit (we can use the rate-scenarios.xlsx you attached). Also include a token-level breakdown (prompt vs completion) in that model.

Next steps: schedule the technical sync — mornings Pacific are best. Also include your SOC2 report and the sandbox access doc in the invite so our security person can join if needed.

Thanks — Erin
Erin Zhao
Product Manager, FinAdvance
erin@finadvance.com
